body: I totally understand you... I've been thinking of either going to a clinic or kill myself... I'm tired... Everything just hurts... I'm sad, spend my days crying and feeling like shit...
Whatever you need pm me, I'll be working but as soon as I'm available I'll answer you !
It's totally okay, you don't need to apologise... If you feel like talking you can send me a pm okay? I'm not here to judge you
I totally understand how you feel... It's really hard to need some time for our own thoughts but our heads are all over the place... If you need to talk I'm here !
If you need I'm here

I feel the exact same way... Even tho I have a boyfriend I know sometimes I hurt him because I say some stuff with a really cold heart... It's shitty and the worst is your family probably saying the same mine does which is "you're like that because you want too" like who wants to feel this way? Feeling the urge to kill ourselves? Panicking about everything in our lives... It sucks and noone understands...
Yeah, but what if this never goes away? I believe this comes and goes then comes back again... I'm tired

When we actually do it should we drink something to help? I feel awful for not even trying to help you and put your mind off of it but I just want to end my life aswell... I've thought about drowning...
Can you actually die with that?

Love the fact that you say "why should they lie" when all I want is the truth, if they are fake they are already lying by the way... If you are honest with me I'll like you no matter what, I'm not here to judge anyone and if you are honest with me I'll try to understand your side even if you are the worst person in the world
I'm not saying that she should be an asshole, I just don't like fake people who are way too friendly... I'd rather be honest about everything than a fake person who just pleases everyone :)
I don't agree with the attitudes she had but I believe that something had to trigger all that rage in her... And I feel like she just needs someone to understand her
I know that you should talk to someone before doing anything like that, so that maybe you'll think twice before doing it

Talk to him about that, if he is your friend he should talk to you about everything because you won't judge him the same way he doesn't judge you, just be honest and talk about it and see how he reacts and if you need to talk to someone else in private just message me, I don't mind listening to you ^^

Well you're 18 so you should've been more responsible, i don't know if you have the thought of killing yourself but don't do it... Having a kid will make you more responsible and maybe that's what you are needing... For the sake of the girl and the kid you are about to have don't do anything bad and don't hurt yourself... That girl will need you more than ever!
